The 2014–15 Missouri State Lady Bears basketball team represented Missouri State University during the 2014–15 NCAA Division I women's basketball season. They were coached by first-year head coach Kellie Harper. The Lady Bears played their home games at Hammons Student Center as members of the Missouri Valley Conference. They finished the season 18-15, 10-8 in MVC play to finish in a tie for fourth place. They advanced to the semifinals of the Missouri Valley women's basketball tournament where they lost to Northern Iowa. They were invited to the Women's National Invitation Tournament, where they lost to Saint Louis in the first round.
